rows.en:
After that, the girls who had taken the cats home died strange deaths one after another: one had her head crushed by something falling at a construction site, another went headfirst through the glass of a door.
Why that happened to them, we can only imagine.
Most likely, they didn't take proper care of their cats.
They say there was always a cat at the scene of each accident.
Maybe leaving those cats with them was Takeda giving them one last chance.
And ever since, they say something haunts the lodging facility.
The headless ghosts of those girls drift around in the middle of the night, searching for their heads.
As soon as I heard that story, I quit the soccer team.
As they say, what you don't touch can't curse you.
{a}, maybe you'd better not pick up stray cats so casually.
But actually, there's still one of them left, you know: a girl who's still keeping the cat Takeda left with her.
I hear she takes very good care of it.
Though who knows how long that will last.
If you know a student at this school who keeps a cat, it might be her.
That's the end of my story.
Next, please.{p}

"W-We don't want to keep any cats!"
"I see, so you won't keep them...
I'm dead, so I can't take care of cats anymore.
And the cats are so very hungry..."
As soon as Takeda said that, the cats around them began attacking the girls one after another.{p}

"Aaagh!"
Many cats, no, dozens of cats bared their fangs at them.
No matter how hard they fought back, they couldn't escape.
One after another, the girls' bodies were torn to pieces by the cats' teeth.
Eventually, Takeda slowly walked up to them.
"N-Naoko, forgive us..."
Takeda smiled.{p}
"Forgive... AAAAAGH!"{p}

...I don't know what happened after that.
All I know is that the next day, several half-eaten corpses were found there.
The bodies were so mangled that no one could tell for sure who they were.
The heads especially had almost no flesh left on them, and not a trace of their brains remained.
And along with signs that cats had attacked them, there were also marks as if a person had bitten chunks out of them.
Ever since, they say the girls' ghosts appear in the lodging facility, searching for their own brains.
When I stayed there for training camp, I happened to see those ghosts, you see.
That's why I decided to quit the soccer team.
I have no intention of joining any other sports team from now on, either.
I never want to use that lodging facility again.
That's the end of my story.
Next person, please.{p}

What a rude way to put it.
Normally, people would try a little harder to smooth it over.
Calling someone a loser like that... you must be a very important person.
So you're on a different side from me, {a}.{p}

"Sodeyama, it seems like everyone's looking at us..."
The moment I said that, everyone looked away at once.
By the time Sodeyama, who had been sorting his things, raised his head, they were all facing in completely different directions.
"Huh? Nobody's looking at us."
Sodeyama went back to putting his things away.
I didn't say anything more, and told myself to stop worrying about what I'd heard earlier.{p}

Why would you say something like that?
Do I look like that kind of person to you?{p}
But that night, I ended up sleeping in Bed 4 in his place.{p}

In the middle of the night I suddenly felt a chill and woke up, and found myself walking across the schoolyard as if someone were controlling me.
What I saw unfolded like a movie, with no regard for my own will.
A huge magic circle had been drawn in the middle of the schoolyard, and men dressed in black were standing there.
Then my body came to a stop in front of those men.
"We will perform the final rite."
With that, one of the men began chanting a spell.{p}

With a loud crackling, a pale blue light appeared.
When he finished the spell, one of the men said this:
"We offer up the sacrifice."
Then my body floated up and drifted toward the pale blue light behind the men.
...I sensed that I was going to die.
But I did manage to get away, you know.
As my body passed over the men's heads, I reached out and pulled off one of their masks.
It was easier than I'd expected.
The man couldn't resist in time.
I peered into the man's face.
"...M-Moriyama...!"
To my surprise, the man was the captain of the soccer team.
And then he grinned at me.
That grin turned my sense of coming death into certainty.
My body kept drawing closer and closer to the pale blue light.{p}

"Stop it!"
It was Sodeyama.
Shouting that, he charged at the men.
Sodeyama fought desperately to stop their ritual.
And he tore up the paper Moriyama was holding.{p}

"Waaagh!"
Moriyama screamed.
At that, the other men froze as well.
At the same moment, my body suddenly dropped.
I slammed into the ground, and I could move freely again.
Moriyama and the rest of the men started to run.
Just then, the pale blue light suddenly blazed brighter.
This time it was Moriyama's body that was dragged into the light with tremendous force.{p}

"N-No, stop! Somebody help me!"
Groaning in agony, Moriyama was sucked into the pale blue light and vanished.{p}

Only Sodeyama and I were left in the schoolyard.
Then I thanked Sodeyama.
"Thank you."
"I'm the one who should thank you. You switched... Bed 4 with me, and that saved me."
Sodeyama and I sat down on the ground of the schoolyard and laughed quietly.{p}

I found out later that some of the seniors, with Moriyama as their representative, had summoned a demon and wished for victory at the upcoming prefectural tournament.
The paper that got torn up that night was a contract with the demon.
Because the contract was torn up, Moriyama, as their representative, became the sacrifice. That's how it worked.
Perhaps thanks to that, the soccer team won the prefectural tournament.
And Sodeyama and I quit the soccer team right away.
...But that wasn't the end of it, you know.
Just between us, I hear Moriyama had once slept in Bed 4 too.
And from that day on, he started secretly summoning the demon, or so they say...
Listen, {a}.
That lodging facility is... haunted, you know.
By a demon.
Even now, I imagine it tempts the students who sleep in Bed 4 into making contracts, or squeezes the life out of them as sacrifices.
This school is famous for sports, but there are rumors that every sports team offers sacrifices to the demon.
Every year, a number of new students go missing, and I hear they're all students who used Bed 4.
The school knows about these incidents and silently lets them happen.
I don't need to tell you why.
{a}, if you ever join a sports team, please be careful.
There's no telling how else they might make you a sacrifice.
That concludes my story.
Next, please.{p}

Would you, really?
If you'd actually been there, I wonder if you could really act like that.
You look like the type who'd abandon a friend without a second thought.
After all, you're one of the people on the ruling side.
Well, I'm different, of course.
Yes.
I went back to the room.
I was worried about Sodeyama.{p}

Yes... that's right.
I was so terrified that I screamed at the top of my lungs.
Then the monster started to come toward me.
And just then...
Sodeyama held the monster back.
"Don't go..."
A faint voice came from under the blanket.
Why did Sodeyama hold the monster back?
Does whoever sleeps in Bed 4 fall under the monster's spell?{p}

The monster turned back toward Sodeyama.
Then, ignoring me, it went back to sucking on Sodeyama's arm.
I stumbled back two or three steps.
I found I could move again.{p}

"Arai, would you go somewhere else?"
It was Sodeyama's voice.
But was it really all right for me to leave him there...?
That's what I thought.
I had a feeling Sodeyama was being controlled.
But...{p}

"Get out of here already☆"
Sodeyama roared at me with a terrifying look on his face.
As if he'd become a completely different person.
So I had no choice but to leave.{p}

The day after I saw the monster, Sodeyama came to school.
With the emptiest eyes you could imagine.
And after that, it seems he would sometimes sneak into that lodging facility.
And here's the strange part...
It seems the teachers saw him and pretended not to notice.
Then, a few days later, Sodeyama disappeared.
The school told us,
"Sodeyama has transferred to another school."
That's what they said, anyway.
I find that a little hard to believe.
What on earth was going on, I wonder?
The monster that appears at Bed 4...
Does that mean they were handing students over to that thing as sacrifices?
.........I really don't know.
{a}.
If you ever end up using that lodging facility, why not try sleeping in Bed 4?
Won't you get to the bottom of this mystery in my place...?
Oh, I see.
You don't want to?
Well, you're one of the people on the ruling side after all.
I suppose you'd never do anything that might get your own hands dirty.
Well then, my story ends here.
It was because of that incident that I quit the soccer team.
It was a truly strange occurrence.
...Let's hear the next person's story.
Now, who will be speaking next?{p}

Yes, all I could do was pray.
But no matter how much I prayed, nothing about the situation changed.
The monster just kept staring at me.
So I didn't know what to do anymore...
I was so tense that my mouth filled with spit.
I spat it out onto the floor.{p}

I see.
In the end, people on the ruling side never understand how the ruled feel, do they?
You're making fun of me, aren't you?
I can tell.
I know perfectly well.
I'm a man who isn't even worth having at this gathering.
Come on, wouldn't it be better to hear the next person's story?
I'm just a loser anyway.
Just leave me alone.{p}I hate you.
Calm him down
Hear the next person's story

...I see.
So you say you want to hear my story.
Handing out the carrot and the stick like that...
That's exactly how people on the ruling side operate, isn't it?
So you really are that kind of person.
...Well, fine.{p}
What do you think I did about the monster?
Scream
Pray
Spit at it

I have never met anyone as rude as you.
It's truly unforgivable.
I realize it now.
I mustn't stop this story.
Even if you don't want to hear it, everyone else gathered here surely wants to hear the rest.
As the one who started this story, it's my responsibility to tell it to the end.
Not for you, but for everyone else.
...Now then, everyone, please listen.{p}

I couldn't do anything against the monster sucking on Sodeyama's arm.
I was so tense I couldn't move; I just stood there in silence.{p}

So I rushed over to Sodeyama in a panic.
"Sodeyama!
Are you all right★"
At that, Sodeyama shot me a glare, got out of bed and went off somewhere.
I thought he must truly hate me now.
And then...{p}

From the first club practice the day after camp ended, Sodeyama was like a different person.
His face had become sharper and his words and actions more direct; he didn't seem at all like the guy who'd been dawdling around on the second team with me.
...That was when it hit me.
Wasn't this the monster's doing?
During camp Sodeyama had seemed unwell, but afterward he was full of energy.
I suppose he'd only felt ill because the training at camp was so hard.
At first, I thought the monster had sucked the life force out of Sodeyama.
But as I watched Sodeyama, a different idea came to me.
Maybe the monster had sucked out Sodeyama's timid heart...
I feel like I read about it somewhere, long ago.
That there are creatures like that.
Some of them even eat people's bad dreams, apparently.{p}

So I went to that Bed 4 to make sure.
I snuck into the lodging facility, even though it was off-limits.
And what do you think I did there?
...Please don't be shocked.{p}

I tried sleeping in Bed 4.
After all, I had more than a little desire to be more assertive myself.
And then...
It came out.
That monster.{p}

The monster slowly took my arm and tried to suck on the back of my hand.
Of course, I didn't resist.
Though having a monster like that beside me was terrifying, I'll admit.
Everyone.
It was a wonderful experience.
It felt so good that I stopped caring how frightening the monster was.
I understood perfectly why Sodeyama had wanted to sleep in Bed 4 that day.
Yes.
I let the monster suck on the back of my hand until it was satisfied.
And as for what happened then...{p}

"A-Arai...?"
Arai got up from his seat and came toward me.
"It's about time I told the story to you as well.
{a}.
I'll tell you something good.
That monster didn't suck out people's timid hearts after all."
"Ara..."
What's happening to me?
I can't move.
As if I'd been caught in Arai's gaze...
"{a}, that was a monster that sucks out a person's conscience.
And so it sucked all the goodness right out of me.
But can something like this really happen in real life?
It's strange.
Truly strange.
I still don't really understand it.
Whatever else it is, Bed 4 is a terrifying bed."{p}

Arai's hands caught me by the neck.
"Come to think of it, {a}..."
Arai stretched his mouth wide from side to side in a devilish grin.
"Earlier, you made fun of me plenty, didn't you?
You see, I'm a man whose conscience has been sucked away.
So I can do anything.
Let's see, for example..."
Suddenly, Arai began strangling me☆

"Ugh...!"
It was so sudden that no one seemed to know what to do.

"Aaaaaaah☆"
A girl screamed.

"{a}, I'll tell you the real reason I left the soccer team.
Actually, I didn't quit; I was made to quit.
I got into a little trouble for violence, you see.
After all, I have no conscience.
Naturally, I get the urge to lash out once or twice.
Even if I am one of the ruled, that doesn't mean I'll put up with absolutely anything.
Ha ha ha ha... Oh, what's the matter?
Can't you even answer me?
You really are rude, aren't you?
Oh, I see, your throat's squeezed so tight you can't make a sound..."

Arai's voice throbbed in my ears.
I couldn't think about anything anymore.
My consciousness just kept slipping away...{p}

When I came to, I was lying on a bed in the nurse's office.
It seemed I'd passed out after being strangled.{p}

"Ah, {a}.
I'm sorry about earlier."
Arai...★
Did Arai carry me to the nurse's office?

I sat up.
My head was aching for some reason.
When I stood up, Arai lent me a hand.
Right now, Arai's expression was gentle.
But I couldn't let my guard down.
If I said anything to make him angry here, I'd be right back on that bed.
I have to be careful...{p}

Arai gave me a warm smile.
"A-Arai, I can get home by myself.
Thank you for carrying me to the nurse's office."
I hurriedly tried to leave on my own.{p}
At that, Arai looked angry for a moment, but then smiled again right away...{p}

Without a word, he reached for my throat.
This time he might not hold back.
I felt that I had once again chosen the wrong way.

I'm going to be strangled.
I'm going to be strangled to death.{p}

That premonition took over my whole heart.
As he choked me, some part of my mind was wondering how much longer it would be until this agony ended...{p}
